details.name: Ember
details.quote: Ember, Knight of the Order of Steel Oath, reporting for duty. As bound by the pact, I shall obey your command until the Crusade concludes.
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Combat Technique: Armored Defender The Order of Steel Oath treats an assault as a means to guard an objective. In the frontlines where the fighting is hardest, the Oathkeepers' defenses serve as a means of attack.
details.exp2d: Constitution: Fortitude "You never run out of things to do in the battlefield. The immensity of your tasks boils down to how unwilling you are to fall."
details.hb1d: Sports: Military Training She is accustomed to life accompanied by sword and warfare. Her crusade is not yet over. She is constantly preparing for it.
details.hb2d: Technology: DIY Repairs Even the most advanced equipment must be properly maintained. A soldier is duty-bound to have complete knowledge of their closest companions.
